name: Capybara Merge Tycoon
desc:
Welcome to Capybara Merge Tycoon! 🍊

Build a giant tower full of chill and colorful Capybaras! They will toss oranges, which you can sell and get even more Capybaras. Merge capybaras to get better ones and become the best player in the WHOLE WORLD!

✨IF YOUR GAME IS LAGGING CREATE A FREE PRIVATE SERVER!!✨

🍊 Unlock tons of cool Capybaras!
💰Sell Oranges to earn lots of coins!
🗼 Build the tallest tower in the world!

INVITE YOUR FRIEND AND GET COOL REWARDS!

Don't forget to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite and 🔔 Follow for new updates!
